data.name: AiGuide.Title
data.value: Using Lettra's AI well

data.name: AiGuide.Subtitle
data.value: What the AI does, what it never does, how to recognise it, turn it off and read its log.

data.name: AiGuide.State.Off
data.value: AI is off

data.name: AiGuide.State.Off.Text
data.value: Lettra works fully without it: rules, calculations, checks and help stay the same. A firm administrator can turn it on and give you the right to use it.

data.name: AiGuide.State.On
data.value: AI is on in this dossier

data.name: AiGuide.State.On.Text
data.value: It suggests, you decide. Every text it writes is flagged, and every request is recorded in the log below.

data.name: AiGuide.State.Paused
data.value: The AI engine is not responding

data.name: AiGuide.State.Paused.Text
data.value: After repeated failures, Lettra stops calling it for a few minutes, then tries again on its own. Meanwhile the assistant answers “engine paused” and everything else works.

data.name: AiGuide.State.Engine
data.value: Engine

data.name: AiGuide.State.Features
data.value: Features turned on

data.name: AiGuide.Does.Title
data.value: What the AI does

data.name: AiGuide.Does.1
data.value: It explains why a compliance check blocks a document (the “Why?” button on the checklist).

data.name: AiGuide.Does.2
data.value: It helps you understand what stops an e-invoice from being sent.

data.name: AiGuide.Does.3
data.value: It answers VAT and regulatory questions, citing the reference sheets and official sites it read.

data.name: AiGuide.Does.4
data.value: For any amount it uses Lettra's calculations; an amount that does not come from them is flagged.

data.name: AiGuide.Never.Title
data.value: What it never does

data.name: AiGuide.Never.1
data.value: Approve, issue or send a document: you always do that yourself.

data.name: AiGuide.Never.2
data.value: Decide instead of the rules: compliance, VAT and amounts are calculated by Lettra, not by the AI.

data.name: AiGuide.Never.3
data.value: See the dossier's names: customers, suppliers and identifiers are replaced by tokens before anything is sent to the engine.

data.name: AiGuide.Never.4
data.value: Score a person's creditworthiness, or assess, assign or monitor staff work.

data.name: AiGuide.Mark.Title
data.value: Recognising AI text

data.name: AiGuide.Mark.1
data.value: Every text written by the AI carries the label “Text written by AI, to be checked”.

data.name: AiGuide.Mark.2
data.value: Hover over the label to see which engine wrote it; the log records it too.

data.name: AiGuide.Mark.3
data.value: Lettra's steps, rules and calculations are shown separately, without that label: they do not come from the AI.

data.name: AiGuide.Mark.4
data.value: The answer also carries a machine-readable mark (AI-generated content) for software that reuses it.

data.name: AiGuide.Off.Title
data.value: Turning it off or on

data.name: AiGuide.Off.1
data.value: AI is off by default, including in the demo.

data.name: AiGuide.Off.2
data.value: A firm administrator turns it on, picks the engine (Claude hosted in Europe, or a model installed at the firm) and turns features on one by one.

data.name: AiGuide.Off.3
data.value: They can exclude a dossier, or turn AI off for the whole firm: the rest of Lettra keeps working.

data.name: AiGuide.Off.4
data.value: On a standalone computer, these settings are in the configuration file.

data.name: AiGuide.Failure.Title
data.value: When the engine does not respond

data.name: AiGuide.Failure.1
data.value: If the engine is slow, drops the connection or sends an unreadable reply, the answer ends on “engine unavailable”; the steps already shown remain valid.

data.name: AiGuide.Failure.2
data.value: After several failures, Lettra stops calling it for a few minutes: the panel shows “AI paused”, then Lettra tries again on its own.

data.name: AiGuide.Failure.3
data.value: Every failure is recorded in the log. Lettra also counts these fallbacks, with no name or dossier, so the team running it can see when an engine stops responding.
